newsitem.title: BELGIUM: City Hotels sets bond issue for Feb 13-19.
newsitem.headline: City Hotels sets bond issue for Feb 13-19.

text.p: Belgian hotels-to-airline group City Hotels said on Friday subscriptions to its planned one billion Belgian franc, five-year convertible bond issue would run from February 13 to 19.
Details of the coupon and issue price would be decided on February 12, City Hotels said in a statement. The exercise price of the warrants would be around 5,500 francs, it said.
Existing shareholders would be given preferential subscription rights during the first three days of the issue in the ratio two bonds for each five shares presently held, it added.
City Hotels reiterated that it planned to use the funds raised through the issue to develop its business in the United States where it is building two new hotels.
Recent hotel sales have cut the group's hotel capacity to 1,545 rooms from 2,196. "City Hotels wishes now to rebuild and enlarge its hotel activities in the U.S.," the company said.
